parse.title: Witch Spells
parse.wikitext: '''Witch Spells''' are cast by witches. To cast witch spells at all, you first need 5 candles bought from the witch merchant at their hideout. == Rituals == There are currently 2 rituals in the game. === Level Grinding Ritual === Arrange 5 candles in the shape of a star, as seen below: [[File:Witch-star-candles.png|thumb|Five candles arranged in a star]] Once the candles are arranged as such, you will earn 1 level every 15 minutes. === Tracking Ritual === You need 3 candles and a heart. Up to 5 candles can be added, but 3 are required to trigger the ritual. Place the three candles in a triangle with the heart in the middle, as seen below: [[File:Witch-tracking-ritual.png|thumb|Three candles in a triangle with a heart in the middle]] Once the placement is complete, say "quaerere" followed by the player's username to track/spy on them. == Praesidium == Praesidium is a remedy crafted at the cauldron inside the Witch House, located in the cemetery. It requires a verbena flower, which spawns randomly across the map. Once you have the flower, get a cup or a bowl from the first town's cooking merchant. A vampire must fill it with blood, and then you can craft Praesidium: with a cup, it makes you immune to neck snap and vampire bites for 20 minutes; with a bowl, 40 minutes. == Temporary Sun Ring == The Temporary Sun Ring is crafted at the cauldron inside the Witch House, located in the cemetery. It grants sunlight immunity but does not provide the Ring gamepass's stat or XP buffs. To craft it, you must be a level 100+ witch and have 1 metal ring (village shop near the arch) and 1 heart. Formerly known as the Temporary Daylight Ring. == Strength Spell == To use the Strength Spell, simply say "Strength!" into chat. == Immortality Spell == Level 2k+. Links your life to an OG vamp. The incantation is "Sanguis tuus vita mea" whilst clicking on an Original Vampire. == Rat Spell == To become a Rat as a witch, you must complete the Rat Alchemist Quest, found at the second village by the randomly appearing quest NPC. The quest requires Witch level 800+. To complete it: defeat 2 different Original Vampire players, craft 1 White Oak Ash Dagger, and visit 8 different map locations. Once the quest is finished, you will obtain a potion that has 20 uses, up to 5 minutes each time, turning you into a rat (Rat Transformation). Seven of the eight locations are known so far: * First village * Second village * Vampire Castle * Werewolf Den * Cemetery * Church (in the first village) * Tavern (in the first village) * 8th location — unknown, still to be found == Inhuman Potion == Level 1000+. You need 1 dagger (Weaponsmith), 1 vampire blood (Vampire shop inside the castle), and 1 heart. Crafted at the cauldron inside the Witch House, located in the cemetery, it grants Original Vampires immunity to the White Oak Ash Dagger for 5 hours. == White Oak Dagger == Crafted at the cauldron inside the Witch House, located in the cemetery. * Witch Level 800+ * 1× White Oak Stake (Shop in second village) – note: the White Oak Stake cannot be dropped, so if crafting you need to buy it * 1× Dagger (Craft with 20 sliver and 400$ at wepeon smith) == Witch Magic Color Change == Crafted at the cauldron inside the Witch House, located in the cemetery. * 1 Colored Fragment * 1 Ruby * 1 Heart The resulting item changes the color of your Witch magic. Fragments spawn randomly across the map and can be violet, black, white, red, green, yellow, cyan, pink, orange, or blue. Note: You need a Pickaxe from the Weapons NPC to mine Ruby — see [[Mining]]. Hearts and the other required materials must be obtained separately. == See also == * [[Witch]] * [[Items]]
